profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Yakima Chief Hops
profile.summary: Dedicated software development professional with over twelve years of professional experience designing, developing and delivering solutions in the fields of business, entertainment and government. As a full stack developer, I have worked on many aspects of solutions from back end database design and implementation, to mid-tier services and API’s, to web and desktop user interfaces built using a variety of technologies.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Lead architect and engineer on an extensible, cloud-based enterprise integration platform using Azure services and C# / .NET, vastly improving company order-to-delivery speed, efficiency, and accuracy.

●	Developed a feature-rich desktop client for business analysts to view high-level and detailed integration statistics, troubleshoot failures, and ensure cross-platform data integrity.

●	Expanded enterprise integrations ecosystem with an administrative front-end using Blazor, back-end data-sync using Windows services, and command-line tooling improving

●	Collaboratively planned and developed a centralized, cross-system API to enable communication across internal and public facing apps and services and laid the groundwork for team contributions with verbose examples and templates.

●	Developed an internal framework of shared libraries used across all .NET applications, leading to reusable components, improved maintainability, and reduced time to bootstrap new applications and functionality.

●	Co-developed three custom mobile applications, both internal and customer facing, using Xamarin and our internal framework bringing our offerings to the pockets of employees, partners, and customers­ alike.

●	Contributed to multiple custom web applications using PHP, Laravel, and JavaScript.

●	Established departmental standards and guidelines for software development, source control, and documentation.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Played key roles in the upgrading and implementation of SharePoint and Office 365 systems and environments tackling issues such as workflow design, search engine optimization, custom webparts, branding/theming and complete ground-up system buildouts. 

●	Full stack developer and consultant working with clients from various industries and with varying needs. 

●	Designed and developed a data-driven web application that consolidated various disconnected data sources into a central repository for improved analysis and data integrity using C#/.NET, SQL Server and Angular JS. 

●	Co-designed and developed a data-driven web application for collecting and analyzing large datasets for a waste management client using C#/.NET, SQL Server and Angular JS, replacing and improving an existing Access-based system immediately improving workflow efficiency and concurrent user access. 

●	Primary technical resource for clients with both in-person and virtual responsibilities including direct client communication, project management, product demonstrations and resource management.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Full stack developer of the company's flagship web products using C#, ASP.net, MVC, SQL Server, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and SOAP/REST services. 

●	Developed multiple single page applications using front-end technologies such as ReactJS, jQuery, AngularJS, HTML5 and CSS3. 

●	Evolved a single server backend .net application into a distributed scalable system using Microsoft Azure storage services and worker roles. 

●	Worked directly with customers and internal customer facing teams to determine solutions to end-user problems and gather requirements for requested functionality. 

●	Rebuilt and maintained the company’s corporate website using Umbraco CMS, HTML, CSS, JavaScript and custom ASP.NET components. 

●	Responsible for establishing company web standards and architecture and helped lead the company into the realm of web development.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Contributed to the design and implementation of a large scale virtual economy including many subsystems such as a micro-transaction store, virtual currency conversion system, and player auction house using C#, JavaScript and SQL Server.

•	Prototyped several Android apps related to an online game including a two-phase authenticator, world map viewer, and multiplayer card game based on the IP using Java, XML and JSON.

•	Designed and implemented a continuous integration build server using on Zutubi Pulse and Perforce, capable of managing the build and deployment needs of multiple teams. In addition, I developed a task-tray style monitoring tool in C# to allow triggering, monitoring and troubleshooting of any build related tasks.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Built a community service layer in C# and SQL Server 2008 including single sign-in for multiple games, friends and community activity feeds, game achievements and high scores, a messaging system, customizable privacy settings, game specific integrations and more.

•	Designed and built a rich community website which implemented the community service API using JavaScript, AJAX and JSON. 

•	Managed and assisted and intern who developed an iPhone game to test integrations into community features.

•	Implemented PayPal’s Website Payments Pro API allowing for virtual currency purchases using PayPal and direct credit card transactions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and engineered a community service layer on top of the server framework which exposed services to game and web clients including: friends, chat, offline messaging, clans/guilds, achievements, game statistics, cross game invitations and more.

•	Helped design and develop a generic in game presence for community features using flash and ActionScript which was capable of being inserted into all upcoming games and websites to provide a common community presentation and feature set.

•	Won an engineering contest to build a 3D space invaders game in 5 hours.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Co-developed GPGnet, a multi-product support client which was the hub for online games, community interaction and multiplayer matchmaking of current and future PC game titles using C#, WinForms and MySQL.

•	Created various community features such as a content vaulting system for mod/map makers, a player award system, a ranked ladder system, public/private chat rooms, instant messaging, customizable and shareable emotes, friends lists, clans, a data driven knowledge base and a volunteer system.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Co-developed a corporate retail Customer Relations Management system C#, ASP.NET and SQL Server.

•	Responsible for design and implementation of UI infrastructure including externalized XML configurations for application flow / navigation and a custom control suite with built in validation and configurations.

•	Contributed to design, implementation and consumption of an ORM and Business Object library which included automatic key-relation lookups and code generation of classes based on database schema.

positions.title: Systems Administrator
positions.description:
•	Administered a domain of 6000 users and 3000 workstations.

•	Webmaster for both the internal base intranet, as well as the public internet site.

•	Built a master station log web application using ASP.NET which was used to record all daily activity in the network control center to a SQL database.

•	Main point of contact for base technical support.
